# List of Figures {.unnumbered .unlisted}

```{=typst}
#context {
  let figs = query(figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-fig"))
  for f in figs {
    let loc = f.location()
    let is-app = state("appendix-mode", false).at(loc)
    if is-app { continue }
    let chap = counter("chapter-for-figs").at(loc).first()
    let fig-nr = counter(figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-fig")).at(loc).first()
    let page-nr = counter(page).at(loc).first()
    let caption-text = if f.caption != none { f.caption.body } else { [] }
    if caption-text == [] { continue }
    let ct = repr(caption-text)
    if ct.len() < 100 { continue }
    [#link(loc)[Figure #chap.#fig-nr #caption-text #box(width: 1fr, repeat[.]) #page-nr] \ ]
    v(0.4em)
  }
}
```

# List of Tables {.unnumbered .unlisted}

```{=typst}
#context {
  let tbls = query(figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-tbl"))
  for t in tbls {
    let loc = t.location()
    let is-app = state("appendix-mode", false).at(loc)
    if is-app { continue }
    let chap = counter("chapter-for-figs").at(loc).first()
    let tbl-nr = counter(figure.where(kind: "quarto-float-tbl")).at(loc).first()
    let page-nr = counter(page).at(loc).first()
    let caption-text = if t.caption != none { t.caption.body } else { [] }
    if caption-text == [] { continue }
    [#link(loc)[Table #chap.#tbl-nr #caption-text #box(width: 1fr, repeat[.]) #page-nr] \ ]
    v(0.4em)
  }
}
```
